title: Inconsistent pattern: Node B reads 0 V but Node C has supply
description: Node B's sensing lead comes loose: it reads about 0 V while still reporting sensor OK. Node C, downstream of B, still has normal voltage — physically impossible in a radial feeder if B truly had no supply.
what_to_look_for: Feeder: DEGRADED, not INTERRUPTION SUSPECTED. The virtual controller does not trip either.
One MEASUREMENT_INCONSISTENT event naming Node B as the suspect.

steps.note: Node B sensing lead loose: reads ~0 V, status still OK
